== Trivia ==
* A [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Riposte riposte] is an offensive action with the intent of hitting one's opponent, made by the fencer who has just parried an attack. The skill icon also shows the correct position of a riposte.
* The warrior on the left side of the [[skill icon]] is wearing [[Warrior Ascalon armor|Ascalon Armor]].
